title: Physiotherapy with integrated virtual reality for patients with severe chronic low back pain: cluster-randomized controlled trial (VARIETY)
comparison_or_design: The contemporaneous randomized VARIETY comparison involving home VR.
excluded: Historical/augmented total controls and month-1 analyses
population_or_material: Patients in the contemporaneous VARIETY cluster-randomized trial arms; retain practice-level clustering separately from participant counts.
requested_items: Table 6 observed T0/T3 arm means/SD and T3 observed n; main Table 3 contrasts explicitly labelled three months; directly reported within-arm ODI improvement in Results. Preserve Table 3/Table 6 discrepancies in separate review records. Exclude external/pooled controls, overall-trajectory contrasts and other visits.
case_specific_rules: Use Table 6 for requested observed T0/T3 summaries and Table 3 rows explicitly labelled three months for adjusted contrasts. Observed and adjusted results are distinct statistical targets. Do not substitute T1 data for T3 to reconcile table differences.
